title: The adequacy functor as a colimit over linearly adequate functors
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a ring A and a module-valued functor F on Alg_A the lemma produces a morphism Q(F) -> F with Q(F) adequate and universal for maps from adequate functors into F (statement lines 1042-1049). The proof proceeds in two displayed steps: it first reduces the universal property to the linearly adequate case, noting that any adequate G sits in an exact sequence K -> L -> G -> 0 with K and L direct sums of linearly adequate functors, so that a bijection on linearly adequate test objects implies one on G; it then constructs Q(F) as the colimit of the linearly adequate functors L_i mapping to F, indexed by the category of such pairs, and reads off adequacy from the colimit lemma and the universal property from the construction (proof lines 1052-1082). The level is H3: the test-object reduction is the conceptual step and the colimit construction is written out with its indexing category specified.
